Name: Reset camera
Text: Press "R" to return the camera to the Behemoth
Trigger (description): Camera is not centered on the Behemoth more than 15 sec

Name: Avoid reefs
Text: You can lower speed of the Behemoth to better navigation control
Trigger (description): - Hit the reef for the first time

Name: RnD Reroll
Text: you can use reroll to get other variants of buildings
Trigger (description): - 5 RnD Lab research and - Reroll not used

Name: Drop capsule
Text: You can drop capsule to reach places with
Trigger (description): - 5 shoots from Mass Driver and - Not use capsule drop for last 5 shots

Name: Power management
Text: Check buildings power consumption You can turn on/off buildings
Trigger (description): - Energy deficit to turn on the building for the first time or - Constructed building wasn't turned on for N minutes (in-game hourse)

Name: Gather ocean resources
Text: Send Freighters to pick up resources
Trigger (description): - N ocean resources scanned and - None ocean resources were gathered

Name: Scanning System Radius
Text: The scanning system automatically scans all objects of interest within its range. You can adjust scan radius and scan speed in the scanning system.
Trigger (description): - N scans fisnished

Name: Crew Assign
Text: Most building require crew to function. You can unassign crew from unused buildings.
Trigger (description): - There is a building without the crew for N minutes and - Crew members were never unassign from building

Name: Production Target Amount
Text: Turn on/off production, set target amount, change resources
Trigger (description): - any production is on but target amount not set for N minutes

Name: Interchangeable Ingredients
Text: Most of the recipes has interchangeable ingredients. You can change which resource to use in the recipe.
Trigger (description): - there are N different resources produced and - the interchangeable resources were never selected

Name: Drone Assign
Trigger (description): - there are N buildings constructed and - the drones were never assigned

Name: Behemoth Roll
Trigger (description): - the roll display more than N degrees

Name: Hull Repair
Trigger (description): - the hull has less than 100% HP for N minutes

Name: Building Repair
Trigger (description): - the building/s has less than 100% HP for N minutes

Name: Waste Management
Text: Waste is generated as a result of building operations and accumulates on deck. There are facilities capable of processing waste to address this issue.
Trigger (description): - First waste placed on the deck

Name: Entropy
Text: Entropy rise from gathering resources, Engine usage and from some buildings. Entropy level can cause the planet response such as sudden storms and other anomalies.
Trigger (description): - Entropy reaches 1st level

Name: Move Backward
Trigger (description): - Some obstacle is in front (less than N meters) of the Behemoth

Name: Utilities and Artifacts usage
Trigger (description): - There is no Artifact or other resources in any utilities block for N minutes and - There is an Artifacts or Utility resources in the Allocation Center and - Open building window with utilities slots

Name: Active Scan
Text: If visibility is low you can use Active Scan to detect objects. To use Active Scan you need to use specific resources in the Scan System.
Trigger (description): - current time - night or current fog - more than 7 And - there are Basic Scanner or Tricoder in the allocation center

Name: Blueprints
Text: You need blueprints for RnD Lab researching. You can find blueprints on the Zephyrus debris.
Trigger (description): - there is no blueprints in the RnD Lab for N minutes

Name: Morale Management
Text: To maintain crew morale on appropriate level produce better food and construct buildings with entertainment services.
Trigger (description): - Morale drops lower than N

Name: Food for crew
Text: Your team should eat regularly, check food supplies, and prepare new food when supplies run low. Higher-quality food is better for boosting morale.
Trigger (description): - Food supplies is low (less than N units of food)

Name: Underground Extractor
Text: There are even more resources underground. To collect them, you need to use the appropriate type of extractor.
Trigger (description): - No undeground resources collected for N discovered islands

Name: Knowledge/Win Condition
Text: You nee to collcet Knowledge to fnish variation and make progress in unlocked the Prism features
